question: Who makes Urban Platter avocado oil
markdown:
Urban Platter avocado oil
is branded and marketed by
Urban Platter
(owned by Daylight Foods in India), and is sourced and manufactured internationally from regions like
Ethiopia
and
Kenya
(processed using partners like Black & Green).
